arxiv-2201-02456.title: Emergence of zero modes in disordered solids under periodic tiling
arxiv-2201-02456.creator: R. Cameron Dennis ∗ , Varda F. Hagh ∗,† , Eric I. Corwin ∗
arxiv-2201-02456.description: Abstract In computational models of particle packings with periodic boundary conditions, it is assumed that the packing is attached to exact copies of itself in all possible directions. The periodicity of the boundary then requires that all of the particles’ images move together. An infinitely repeated structure, on the other hand, does not necessarily have this constraint.

arxiv-2303-10579.title: Spin Calogero-Moser periodic chains and two dimensional Yang-Mills theory with corners.
arxiv-2303-10579.creator: Nicolai Reshetikhin
arxiv-2303-10579.description: Abstract . Quantum Calogero-Moser spin system is a superintegable system with the spectrum of commuting Hamiltonians that can be described entirely in terms of representation theory of corresponding simple Lie group. In this paper the underlying Lie group G G is a compact connected, simply connected simple Lie group. It has a natural generalization known as quantum Calogero-Moser spin chain.

arxiv-2311-10145.title: The majoron coupling to charged leptons
arxiv-2311-10145.creator: Antonio Herrero-Brocal
arxiv-2311-10145.description: Abstract The particle spectrum of all Majorana neutrino mass models with spontaneous violation of global lepton number include a Goldstone boson, the so-called majoron. The presence of this massless pseudoscalar changes the phenomenology dramatically. In this work we derive general analytical expressions for the 1-loop coupling of the majoron to charged leptons.

arxiv-2312-17576.creator: Francesca Pelusi, Daniele Filippi, Ladislav Derzsi, Matteo Pierno, Mauro Sbragaglia
arxiv-2312-17576.description: Abstract The flow of emulsions in confined microfluidic channels is affected by surface roughness. Directional roughness effects have recently been reported in channels with asymmetric boundary conditions featuring a flat wall, and a wall textured with a directional roughness, the latter promoting a change in the velocity profiles when the flow direction of emulsions is inverted [D. Filippi et al.

arxiv-2403-06553.title: Unconventional topological mixed-state transition and critical phase induced by self-dual coherent errors
arxiv-2403-06553.creator: Yu-Hsueh Chen, Tarun Grover
arxiv-2403-06553.description: Abstract A topological phase can undergo a phase transition driven by anyon condensation. A potential obstruction to such a mechanism could arise if there exists a symmetry between anyons that have non-trivial mutual statistics. Here we consider toric code subjected to errors that tend to proliferate anyons with non-trivial mutual statistics.

arxiv-2403-14576.title: Fully Evaluated Left-Sequential Logics
arxiv-2403-14576.creator: Alban Ponse & Daan J.C. Staudt
arxiv-2403-14576.description: Abstract We consider a family of two-valued “fully evaluated left-sequential logics” (FELs), of which Free FEL (defined by Staudt in 2012) is most distinguishing (weakest) and immune to atomic side effects. Next is Memorising FEL, in which evaluations of subexpressions are memorised. The following stronger logic is Conditional FEL (inspired by Guzmán and Squier’s Conditional logic, 1990).

arxiv-2505-20297.title: DiSA: Diffusion Step Annealing in Autoregressive Image Generation
arxiv-2505-20297.creator: Qinyu Zhao, Jaskirat Singh, Ming Xu, Akshay Asthana, Stephen Gould, Liang Zheng
arxiv-2505-20297.description: Abstract An increasing number of autoregressive models, such as MAR, FlowAR, xAR, and Harmon adopt diffusion sampling to improve the quality of image generation. However, this strategy leads to low inference efficiency, because it usually takes 50 to 100 steps for diffusion to sample a token. This paper explores how to effectively address this issue.

arxiv-2601-21060.title: Human-LLM Collaborative Feature Engineering for Tabular Learning
arxiv-2601-21060.creator: Zhuoyan Li, Aditya Bansal, Jinzhao Li, Shishuang He, Zhuoran Lu, Mutian Zhang, Yiwei Yang, Qin Liu, Swati Jain, Ming Yin, Yunyao Li, [0.5em] Purdue University
arxiv-2601-21060.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Zhuoyan Li, Aditya Bansal, Jinzhao Li, Shishuang He, Zhuoran Lu, Mutian Zhang, Yiwei Yang, Qin Liu, Swati Jain, Ming Yin, Yunyao Li, [0.5em] Purdue University. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate feature engineering in tabular learning. Given task-specific information, LLMs can propose diverse feature transformation operations to enhance downstream model performance.

pmc-10615237.title: Implementation of a Multisectoral Approach to Address Adolescent Pregnancy: A Case Study of Subnational Advocacy Informing National Scale-Up in Kenya
pmc-10615237.creator: Beatrice Kwachi, Sally Njiri, Sam Mulyanga, Irene Choge, Rammah Mwalimu, Susan Ontiri
pmc-10615237.description: Implementation of a multisectoral initiative to address adolescent pregnancy in Kenya required strong leadership and ownership at both national and subnational levels. Advocacy is key to harnessing leadership, ownership, and scale-up. BACKGROUND Adolescent pregnancy, defined as the occurrence of pregnancy in girls aged 10–19 years, continues to be a global phenomenon, especially in sub-Saharan Africa, where the prevalence is 19.3%.

pmc-10730734.title: An ecological study protocol for the multimodal investigation of the neurophysiological underpinnings of dyadic joint action
pmc-10730734.creator: Gabriella Tamburro, Patrique Fiedler, Antonio De Fano, Khadijeh Raeisi, Mohammad Khazaei, Lucia Vaquero, Ricardo Bruña, Hannes Oppermann, Maurizio Bertollo, Edson Filho, Filippo Zappasodi, Silvia Comani
pmc-10730734.description: A novel multimodal experimental setup and dyadic study protocol were designed to investigate the neurophysiological underpinnings of joint action through the synchronous acquisition of EEG, ECG, EMG, respiration and kinematic data from two individuals engaged in ecologic and naturalistic cooperative and competitive joint actions involving face-to-face real-time and real-space coordinated full body movements.

pmc-11379556.title: Characteristics of river heatwaves in the Vistula River basin, Europe
pmc-11379556.creator: Quan Zhou, Fabio Di Nunno, Jiang Sun, Mariusz Sojka, Mariusz Ptak, Yun Qian, Senlin Zhu, Francesco Granata
pmc-11379556.description: Rivers worldwide are warming due to the impact of climate change and human interventions. This study investigated river heatwaves in the Vistula River Basin, one of the largest river systems in Europe using long-term observed daily river water temperatures from the past 30 years (1991–2020).

pmc-11591196.title: High Prevalence of Dysfunctional Animal–Visitor Interactions in 225 Southeast Asian Zoos and Aquariums
pmc-11591196.creator: Anna Fourage, Tanya Erzinclioglu, Amanda Fairey, Marco Campera, K. Anne-Isola Nekaris, Vincent Nijman
pmc-11591196.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryAnimal–visitor interactions are a component of zoo and aquarium entertainment and include activities such as petting, taking selfies, feeding, and animal shows and presentations. Well-managed animal–visitor interactions should provide good animal welfare and promote pro-conservation behaviours in visitors. In reality, some animal–visitor interactions may be dysfunctional as they create more harm than good, which undermines some of the objectives of a modern zoo and goes against zoological associations’ guidelines on animal–visitor interactions.

pmc-11596302.title: Comparison of Prognostic Values of Seven Immune Indexes in Advanced Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer Treated with Nivolumab: How Effective Can They Be Regarding Our Treatment Decisions?
pmc-11596302.creator: Arife Ulas, Beyza Temel, Fahriye Tugba Kos, Konstantinos Dimas
pmc-11596302.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background and Objectives: In this study, we evaluated the impact of seven immune indexes on treatment response and survival outcomes in advanced non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients receiving second-line and subsequent nivolumab treatment under real-life conditions. Materials and Methods: The pan-immune inflammation value (PIV), systemic immune inflammation value (SII), neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio (PLR), monocyte-to-lymphocyte ratio (MLR), derived neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (d-NLR), and prognostic nutritional index (PNI) were calculated. All immune indexes were classified as low and high based on cut-off values.

pmc-11663776.title: Genetic and vascular risk factors for ischemic stroke and cortical morphometry in individuals without a history of stroke: A UK Biobank observational cohort study
pmc-11663776.creator: Jiawei Liu, Yingying Xie, Feng Liu, Wen Qin, Chunshui Yu
pmc-11663776.description: Highlights•Stroke risk factors were associated with 18 CT and SA phenotypes, which could explain portions of variances in these phenotypes.•PRSIS and DBP had more extensive and complex effects on reliable cortical phenotypes than SBP, HbA1c, and TG.•Vascular risk factors within normal ranges still influence cortical phenotypes.•Cortical phenotypes mediated the associations of PRSIS and SBP with FIQ.

pmc-12447766.title: Prevalence and predictors of post-COVID-19-related symptoms: an extended follow-up among employees in health and welfare services in Germany: a short report
pmc-12447766.creator: Peter Koch, Lara Steinke, Claudia Peters, Albert Nienhaus
pmc-12447766.description: Objective: To describe persistent symptoms after a work-related COVID-19 infection in health and welfare workers and the identification of predictors of these symptoms.Methods: This short report summarises updated results on a bidirectional cohort study of employees in the health and welfare services who had reported a work-related SARS-CoV-2 infection in 2020.

pmc-13079959.title: Continuous Intraoperative Recurrent Laryngeal Nerve Monitoring in Transcervical Inflatable Mediastinoscopic Esophagectomy
pmc-13079959.creator: Luo Zhao, Zhijun Han, Yisheng Zhang, Zijia Liu, Jia He, Li Li
pmc-13079959.description: Transcervical inflatable mediastinoscopic esophagectomy (TIME), with fewer incisions and without going through the thoracic cavity, may achieve the same results and lymph node dissection compared with Thoracoscopic assisted minimally invasive esophagectomy (TAMIE). However, its small visual field increases recurrent laryngeal nerve (RLN) injury risk.

pmc-13101753.title: Machine Learning Models Predicting Solubility and Polymerizability of Polyimides Considering Multiple Monomers for CO2 Separation Membranes
pmc-13101753.creator: Yuto Shino, Motosuke Katayama, Yuri Ito, Hiromasa Kaneko
pmc-13101753.description: Membrane technologies for the separation of gases, such as CO2/CH4 mixtures, have attracted attention because of their high energy efficiency. Polyimides are considered promising membrane materials for CO2 separation, and there is a growing demand for materials with even higher performance.

pmc-13585450.title: Hyperestrogenic imprinting and developmental origins of endometriosis and adenomyosis
pmc-13585450.creator: Sun-Wei Guo, Paola Viganò
pmc-13585450.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The pathogenesis of endometriosis and adenomyosis remains incompletely understood, and a notable gap persists between the reported heritability and the disease variation explained by identified susceptibility loci. In this manuscript, we showcase key epidemiological and clinical observations—including associations with early menarche, shorter anogenital distance, specific childhood growth trajectories, hypospadias in males, and developmental exposure to endocrine-disrupting chemicals—that collectively point to the influence of early-life developmental programming.
